title: Research report on three ways to read the formula

tellings.quote: So, one of the first pieces of research we got back on it was like a 20page whatever that broke into like the three main ways to interpret it are

plain: On the Jesse Michels podcast, Bryce Zabel talks about a formula he and others were studying sometime around 2024 to 2026. He says one of the first pieces of research that came back to them was a report of about 20 pages that laid out the three main ways to interpret it. He does not say much more about what the formula is or what the three readings were.
